purpose: The authored bridge between a measured query and the material library. Measured demand (data/demand/measured_demand.json, ranked by data/authority_scale/query_atlas.json) names what people actually searched for; data/content/phase4_material_library.json holds the only writing this repo is allowed to compose from. Nothing here invents material: each entry says which authored axis value a phrase in a real query refers to, and why. A query that matches nothing is refused by name in reports/content/demand_backed_composition.json rather than templated.
hard_rules: A phrase may only map to an axis value that already exists in phase4_material_library.json.
Matching consumes spans longest-first, so 'ai executive coach' never also counts as the 'executive' audience.

One (primary, secondary) axis pair may compose at most one page per run. A second query landing on the same pair is refused, because two pages built from the same two axis entries differ only in their title - which is the keyword-swap failure this repo already retired 743 pages over.

default_secondary is an editorial decision recorded here, not a fallback that fires silently: it is only declared for primary values where one authored dimension is what the comparison is actually about.

tool|AI prompt pack.why: What separates a prompt pack from an operating structure is which prompt fires when, which is exactly the authored prompt-structure dimension.

tool|human executive coach.why: The authored entry's own distinguishing point is a person who meets you fortnightly against something that runs daily, which is the accountability dimension.

tool|generic ChatGPT chat.why: The authored entry's distinguishing point is whether constraints arrive with the question or have to be retyped.

tool|therapy.why: The honest comparison against therapy is a boundary question, which is the authored dimension for it.

tool|productivity app.why: The authored entry's distinguishing point is that storage does not decide order.

tool|accountability app.why: The authored entry is about what happens on the day you miss.

tool|coaching retainer.why: The authored entry is about paying for access and what runs between sessions.

tool|habit tracker.why: The authored entry is about what the streak does and does not cause.
